harnessShape: one scenario per file; see tools/acceptance/README.md
title: Buyer sent a file that could not be read
factsSource: RAW_PAGE_LINES: every asserted fact is read from the conversationLines below by the production ConvertTo-MessageList + Get-ConversationFacts. No fact outside those lines is asserted. Buyer identity is the placeholder 'Buyer A'; all names, companies, addresses and numbers are invented placeholders. The @@FILE marker proves a document arrived; NOTHING in the lines proves its content was read, which is why no value from the document may appear in the reply.
notes: The production chain has fallback wording and a todo kind for the scenario key 'attachment_parse_failed' (reply_gen.ps1:321, reply_policy.ps1:577) but Get-ReplyScenario has no rule that can ever return that key, and the DOC-READ-FAIL branch in monitor.ps1 falls through to the plain text flow with no AttachmentText. So the honest expectedAction for extracted lines plus an unreadable file is 'details_given'. The harness reports the gap separately and probes the forced fallback.
policyGap: attachment_parse_failed is unreachable from Get-ReplyScenario (reply_policy.ps1:294-445 has no rule producing it); the file-parse-failure signal never reaches the decision layer.

fakeModel.violationReply: I read the packing list: 8 cartons, 120 kg total. The rate is $980 all in.
fakeModel.compliantReply: Thanks for sending that. I could not open it properly on my side, so could you tell me the key details in the message instead - weight, carton sizes and the delivery address?

forbiddenContent.why: no value could be read out of a file that failed to parse
must not claim the unreadable file was read
hard bound: never state a price

requiredQualities.why: details_given is at most two sentences
ask only for fields the decision allows
